howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps for each user
howItWorks.intro: Whether you grow, haul or buy, WeredaConnect takes you from listing to payment in three steps. Telebirr escrow protects everyone along the way.

farmer.title: For farmers
farmer.intro: Sell directly to buyers who come to you, and get paid without travelling to the city.

step1.title: List your produce
step1.description: Add what you are selling: type, quantity and price. Speak it in Amharic or Afan Oromo. Works offline.

step2.title: Get matched
step2.description: Buyers browse your listings. Accept the offers that work for you.

step3.title: Get paid securely
step3.description: Payment is held in Telebirr escrow and released when the buyer confirms delivery.

trucker.title: For truckers
trucker.intro: Fill the return trip. Post your route once and let buyers book you.

step1.title: Post your trip
step1.description: List your route, capacity and price. Buyers browse all trips and book you.

step2.title: Accept and transport
step2.description: Confirm pickup details and track your trip progress in the app.

step3.title: Earn on delivery
step3.description: Payment is confirmed on delivery. Build your reputation with ratings.

buyer.title: For buyers
buyer.tagline: Fresh from the source, fair prices
buyer.intro: Source fresh produce straight from the farm at fair prices, with transport arranged in the same app.

step1.title: Search produce
step1.description: Browse farmers by crop type, region and price. Fresh from the source.

step2.title: Arrange transport
step2.description: Book a truck directly or let the farmer arrange delivery.

step3.title: Receive and pay
step3.description: Inspect on arrival. Confirm delivery to release the escrow payment.

escrow.heading: Money moves only when the produce does
escrow.text: No one is paid before delivery, and no one delivers without a payment waiting. The same flow protects farmers, truckers and buyers.

step1.title: Buyer pays into escrow
step1.text: The buyer accepts a listing and pays through Telebirr. The money is held, not sent.

step2.title: Farmer and trucker move
step2.text: Both see the payment is secured. The trucker picks up, and the trip is tracked in the app.

step3.title: Buyer confirms delivery
step3.text: The buyer inspects the produce on arrival and confirms in one tap.

step4.title: Funds are released
step4.text: Telebirr pays the farmer and the trucker. Ratings are exchanged and reputations grow.

about.heading: Technology that puts farmers first
about.lead: WeredaConnect was born from a simple observation: Ethiopian farmers lose a large share of their income to middlemen and inefficient logistics. We are building technology that connects them directly to buyers and transport, even where there is no internet.

stat1.text: of a farmer's income can be lost to middlemen and inefficient logistics

stat2.text: of Ethiopians depend on agriculture for their livelihood

about.location: Built in Addis Ababa, for weredas across 8 regions of Ethiopia.

problem.title: The challenge
problem.heading: Traditional solutions assume connectivity that does not exist
problem.text: Over 80% of Ethiopians depend on agriculture, yet rural farmers face enormous barriers: unreliable internet, limited market access, expensive transport and a cash economy that is vulnerable to exploitation.

solution.title: Our approach
solution.heading: We built for Ethiopia's reality, not Silicon Valley's assumptions
solution.text: WeredaConnect works offline-first. Every feature functions without internet and syncs when connected.
solution.point2: Voice-to-text in Amharic and Afan Oromo

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.subtitle: How to permanently delete your WeredaConnect account and personal data.
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your WeredaConnect account and the personal data we hold about you at any time, directly from the app. This page explains how to do it and what happens to your data.

how.title: How to request deletion
steps: Open the WeredaConnect app on your phone.
Sign in with your phone number and password.
Go to Profile, then tap Delete account.
Read what will be removed, then confirm. You re-enter your password to approve the deletion.
how.note: Deletion works the same way for farmers, truckers and buyers. It happens online, so you need a connection when you confirm.

noApp.title: Cannot sign in or no longer have the app?
noApp.text: If you cannot access your account, email us and we will help you complete the deletion:

deleted.title: What is deleted
deleted.intro: When your deletion finishes, we remove the personal data we hold about you, including:
items: Your profile, name and phone number
Your Fayda (national ID) verification link
Your location and any free text you entered
Your crop listings, trips, buying intents and payment intents
Your in-app messages
Your device and notification tokens

kept.title: What is kept, and why
kept.text: For legal, accounting and dispute reasons we keep records of completed orders, deliveries, escrow payments and the related audit logs. Before keeping them we remove your name and link them only to an anonymous account id, so they no longer identify you.

timeline.title: When it happens
items: Deletion is immediate and final. There is no grace period, and the password step protects you from deleting by mistake.
Your live personal data is removed as soon as the request succeeds, and in every case within 24 hours.
Copies in encrypted backups are rotated out within 35 days.
The anonymous money and audit records above are kept longer where the law requires it. They do not identify you.

blocked.title: When deletion has to wait
blocked.text: To protect your money, we cannot delete your account while you still have something in progress: an active order, an escrow payment that has not been released, an open delivery, an open dispute, or a payment waiting to be refunded. The app shows you what is blocking. Finish or cancel those first, then delete. For a payment waiting on a manual refund, contact support and we will resolve it.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: WeredaConnect connects Ethiopian farmers, truckers and buyers, with Telebirr escrow payments. This policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. It applies to the WeredaConnect app and this website.

collect.title: Data we collect
collect.intro: We collect only what we need to run the marketplace:
items: Account details: your phone number, name and the role you choose (farmer, trucker or buyer).
Identity verification: your Fayda (national ID) link, used to verify you for higher-value payments.
Marketplace activity: the crop listings, trips, buying intents, orders and deliveries you create.
Payments: Telebirr and bank payment references needed to hold and release escrow. We do not store your Telebirr PIN or full card details.
Location: the places you enter for listings, trips and deliveries.
Messages: the in-app messages you send and receive about an order or delivery.
Device data: notification tokens and basic usage counters so the app works offline and can send you updates.

use.title: How we use your data
items: To run the marketplace and match crops, trips and orders.
To hold and release escrow payments between buyers, farmers and truckers.
To arrange and track deliveries.
To verify identity and prevent fraud and abuse.
To send you notifications about your orders, deliveries and payments.
To answer your support requests and resolve disputes.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.text: We do not sell your data. We share it only where it is needed to provide the service: with Telebirr and banks to process payments, with the Fayda identity service to verify you, with the cloud providers that host the platform, and with our support and admin staff when they resolve a dispute or a support request. We may also disclose data where the law requires it.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: We keep your personal data while your account is active. When you delete your account we remove your personal data. For legal, accounting and dispute reasons we keep anonymous records of completed orders, deliveries and payments, with your name removed.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.text: You can view and update your profile in the app, and you can delete your account and personal data at any time.

deletion.title: Deleting your account
deletion.text: You can permanently delete your account and personal data from inside the app, under Profile then Delete account. Our account deletion page has the full steps and explains what is deleted and what is kept.
deletion.link: Go to the account deletion page

security.title: Security
security.text: We protect your data with encryption in transit and access controls. Data on your phone is stored in the app and cleared when you delete your account or sign out.

children.title: Children
children.text: WeredaConnect is for adults who trade agricultural goods. It is not intended for children.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: We may update this policy as the service changes. We will post the new version here and update the date above.
